brief.ask: Create the brand family for Lumenfold, the office suite in this monorepo: the Lumenfold master brand and product icons for Lumenfold Docs, Sheets and Sign.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: privacy-first and European, calm and precise. The three product icons must clearly belong to one family and still be told apart at small sizes. Web apps only.

claim.notes: Üç konsept de iki turda eleştirmenin kalite kapısını geçemedi (kör ortalamalar 5,8/5,2/4,6), bu yüzden finalize, export, install-assets ve galeri adımları yapılmadı.

concepts.title: Aperture
readsAs: a stencil D or a price tag
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s6 '///' slashes - code-comment / tally marks / three-stripe sportswear echo; its Sign member is an exclamation mark or italic I, Docs is '//' (struck: glyph + UI reading). s7 master: a dark door with light spilling out of it - first reading matches the hook, the only one that does; but Sign member is a pause button (two bars), Sheets is an M / bar-wedge-bar, Docs is nearly identical to master at 16 px. s8 horizontal bars of growing length = sort/list icon or bar chart, also a stepped cut of a triangle; 78% legibility, members collapse to generic triangles (struck). Keep in s7: the amber wedge fanning from a dark leaf - make the WEDGE the hero (larger, its angle and outer edge carry the identity), the leaf narrower and slightly turned so it reads as a door, not a bar. Fix: never two parallel uprights of similar width (pause icon); members must vary the wedge (angle, spread, which edge it leaves from) not add/remove slabs; Docs must differ visibly from master at 16 px; drop the 3-part Sheets. Risk to watch: 'light gets out' can read as a leak for a privacy brand - keep the opening narrow and controlled, calm not dramatic; avoid a literal door frame or handle.

concepts.title: Crease
readsAs: a flag on a pole (golf hole marker)
a bookmark or folded page corner drawn as two loose blocks
concepts.sketchNotes: Round 2: ribbon folded on a 45 degree crease, front green/back amber. s1 read as a house/lampshade, s3 as a sunrise.

concepts.title: Shared Ground
readsAs: a split square / two interlocking L-blocks (an L with a stepped cut)
a staircase or bar chart (Sheets) and a split pie (Sign)
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 Illustrator/Figma Pathfinder 'intersect' and a copy icon (struck); s2 exactly the Pathfinder intersect icon (struck); s3 two squares meeting corner to corner, a checker/bow; s4 a medicine capsule in brackets, '(0)', Sheets member a hamburger/burger (struck: pharma misreading and glyph). Pick s3: most abstract, calm, survives 16 px (99%), warm terracotta clears the blue-violet band. Risks: reads as a generic checker or Pathfinder 'exclude'; the square void - the whole idea - disappears at 16 px, enlarge or articulate it. Members currently abandon the language (Docs = a vertical cut/pause, Sheets = horizontal stripes/hamburger, Sign = a mirror of master, indistinguishable at 16 px). Rebuild members from the same two-L-plus-void grammar, varying the void's position or proportion, so each has its own silhouette.
